 11868	/// Scan the implementation crates' non-test sources for concurrency
 11869	/// primitives. A file's trailing `#[cfg(test)]` module is skipped; comment
 11870	/// lines are skipped. Deterministic order: crates, files and lines sorted.
 11871	fn scan_concurrency_primitives(root: &Utf8Path) -> Result<ConcurrencyScan> {
 11872	    fn walk(dir: &Utf8Path, out: &mut Vec<Utf8PathBuf>) -> Result<()> {
 11873	        let mut entries = fs::read_dir(dir.as_std_path())
 11874	            .with_context(|| format!("read {dir}"))?
 11875	            .map(|entry| entry.map(|e| e.path()))
 11876	            .collect::<std::io::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
 11877	        entries.sort();
 11878	        for path in entries {
 11879	            let path = Utf8PathBuf::from_path_buf(path)
 11880	                .map_err(|p| anyhow::anyhow!("non-UTF-8 path {}", p.display()))?;
 11881	            if path.is_dir() {
 11882	                walk(&path, out)?;
 11883	            } else if path.extension() == Some("rs") {
 11884	                out.push(path);
 11885	            }
 11886	        }
 11887	        Ok(())
 11888	    }
 11889	    let mut scan = ConcurrencyScan {
 11890	        execution: Vec::new(),
 11891	        sync: Vec::new(),
 11892	    };
 11893	    let crates_dir = root.join("crates");
 11894	    let mut crate_dirs = fs::read_dir(crates_dir.as_std_path())
 11895	        .with_context(|| format!("read {crates_dir}"))?
 11896	        .map(|entry| entry.map(|e| e.path()))
 11897	        .collect::<std::io::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
 11898	    crate_dirs.sort();
 11899	    for member in crate_dirs {
 11900	        let member_dir = Utf8PathBuf::from_path_buf(member)
 11901	            .map_err(|p| anyhow::anyhow!("non-UTF-8 path {}", p.display()))?;
 11902	        let Some(name) = member_dir.file_name() else {
 11903	            continue;
 11904	        };
 11905	        if CONCURRENCY_SCAN_EXCLUDED_CRATES.contains(&name) || !member_dir.join("src").is_dir() {
 11906	            continue;
 11907	        }
 11908	        let manifest = member_dir.join("Cargo.toml");
 11909	        if manifest.is_file() {
 11910	            let external = runtime_external_dependencies(&manifest)?;
 11911	            let unknown = external
 11912	                .iter()
 11913	                .filter(|dep| !CONCURRENCY_SCAN_ALLOWED_DEPENDENCIES.contains(&dep.as_str()))
 11914	                .cloned()
 11915	                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 11916	            anyhow::ensure!(
 11917	                unknown.is_empty(),
 11918	                "{name} depends on {unknown:?}, outside the closed list the \
 11919	                 concurrency scan reasons about; a dependency may export a \
 11920	                 macro that spawns, which a lexical scan cannot see. Decide, \
 11921	                 then widen CONCURRENCY_SCAN_ALLOWED_DEPENDENCIES"
 11922	            );
 11923	        }
 11924	        let mut files = Vec::new();
 11925	        walk(&member_dir.join("src"), &mut files)?;
 11926	        for file in files {
 11927	            let text = fs::read_to_string(&file).with_context(|| format!("read {file}"))?;
 11928	            let relative = file.strip_prefix(root).unwrap_or(&file);
 11929	            // Blind pass 1 at 612cbcc (A06): this used to stop at the first
 11930	            // `#[cfg(test)]` line, so production code after an earlier test
 11931	            // module escaped the scan. The attributed item is skipped as a
 11932	            // block (brace depth) or, for a brace-less item, through its `;`,
 11933	            // and scanning resumes after it. F-56: braces used to be
 11934	            // counted textually, strings and comments included, so an
 11935	            // unbalanced brace inside a test module could end the skip late
 11936	            // and hide a production spawn. Only structural braces count now,
 11937	            // the same scanner the mutant anchor screen uses.
 11938	            let mut skipping: Option<(usize, bool)> = None;
 11939	            let mut scanner = SourceScanner::default();
 11940	            for (index, line) in text.lines().enumerate() {
 11941	                let trimmed = line.trim();
 11942	                let structural = scanner.structural(line);
 11943	                if let Some((depth, entered)) = skipping.as_mut() {
 11944	                    *depth += structural.matches('{').count();
 11945	                    let closes = structural.matches('}').count();
 11946	                    if *depth > 0 {
 11947	                        *entered = true;
 11948	                    }
 11949	                    *depth = depth.saturating_sub(closes);
 11950	                    if (*entered && *depth == 0) || (!*entered && trimmed.ends_with(';')) {
 11951	                        skipping = None;
 11952	                    }
 11953	                    continue;
 11954	                }
 11955	                if trimmed.replace(' ', "") == "#[cfg(test)]" {
 11956	                    skipping = Some((0, false));
 11957	                    continue;
 11958	                }
 11959	                if trimmed.starts_with("//") {
 11960	                    continue;
 11961	                }
 11962	                for token in CONCURRENCY_EXECUTION_PRIMITIVES {
 11963	                    if line.contains(token) {
 11964	                        scan.execution
 11965	                            .push(format!("{relative}:{}:{token}", index + 1));
 11966	                    }
 11967	                }
 11968	                for token in CONCURRENCY_SYNC_PRIMITIVES {
 11969	                    if line.contains(token) {
 11970	                        scan.sync.push(format!("{relative}:{}:{token}", index + 1));
 11971	                    }
 11972	                }
 11973	            }
 11974	        }
 11975	    }
 11976	    Ok(scan)
 11977	}

 11803	/// The external crates `manifest` depends on at run time, workspace members
 11804	/// excluded. Dev-dependencies are excluded too: the scan reads `src/` only,
 11805	/// which a dev-dependency cannot reach.
 11806	fn runtime_external_dependencies(manifest: &Utf8Path) -> Result<BTreeSet<String>> {
 11807	    let text = fs::read_to_string(manifest).with_context(|| format!("read {manifest}"))?;
 11808	    let mut section = String::new();
 11809	    let mut out = BTreeSet::new();
 11810	    for line in text.lines() {
 11811	        let trimmed = line.trim();
 11812	        if let Some(name) = trimmed.strip_prefix('[').and_then(|r| r.strip_suffix(']')) {
 11813	            section.clear();
 11814	            section.push_str(name);
 11815	            continue;
 11816	        }
 11817	        let last = section.rsplit('.').next().unwrap_or_default();
 11818	        if last != "dependencies" || section.contains("dev-") || section.contains("build-") {
 11819	            continue;
 11820	        }
 11821	        let Some((key, _)) = trimmed.split_once('=') else {
 11822	            continue;
 11823	        };
 11824	        let key = key.trim().trim_matches('"');
 11825	        // `serde.workspace = true` names the crate before the dot.
 11826	        let key = key.split('.').next().unwrap_or(key);
 11827	        if key.is_empty() || key.starts_with('#') || key.starts_with("liminal") {
 11828	            continue;
 11829	        }
 11830	        out.insert(key.to_owned());
 11831	    }
 11832	    Ok(out)
 11833	}

 11868	/// Scan the implementation crates' non-test sources for concurrency
 11869	/// primitives. A file's trailing `#[cfg(test)]` module is skipped; comment
 11870	/// lines are skipped. Deterministic order: crates, files and lines sorted.
 11871	fn scan_concurrency_primitives(root: &Utf8Path) -> Result<ConcurrencyScan> {
 11872	    fn walk(dir: &Utf8Path, out: &mut Vec<Utf8PathBuf>) -> Result<()> {
 11873	        let mut entries = fs::read_dir(dir.as_std_path())
 11874	            .with_context(|| format!("read {dir}"))?
 11875	            .map(|entry| entry.map(|e| e.path()))
 11876	            .collect::<std::io::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
 11877	        entries.sort();
 11878	        for path in entries {
 11879	            let path = Utf8PathBuf::from_path_buf(path)
 11880	                .map_err(|p| anyhow::anyhow!("non-UTF-8 path {}", p.display()))?;
 11881	            if path.is_dir() {
 11882	                walk(&path, out)?;

 11891	        sync: Vec::new(),

 11895	        .with_context(|| format!("read {crates_dir}"))?
 11896	        .map(|entry| entry.map(|e| e.path()))
 11897	        .collect::<std::io::Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
 11898	    crate_dirs.sort();
 11899	    for member in crate_dirs {
 11900	        let member_dir = Utf8PathBuf::from_path_buf(member)
 11901	            .map_err(|p| anyhow::anyhow!("non-UTF-8 path {}", p.display()))?;

 11903	            continue;
 11904	        };
 11905	        if CONCURRENCY_SCAN_EXCLUDED_CRATES.contains(&name) || !member_dir.join("src").is_dir() {

 11921	                 then widen CONCURRENCY_SCAN_ALLOWED_DEPENDENCIES"
 11922	            );
 11923	        }

 11925	        walk(&member_dir.join("src"), &mut files)?;
 11926	        for file in files {
 11927	            let text = fs::read_to_string(&file).with_context(|| format!("read {file}"))?;

 11929	            // Blind pass 1 at 612cbcc (A06): this used to stop at the first
 11930	            // `#[cfg(test)]` line, so production code after an earlier test
 11931	            // module escaped the scan. The attributed item is skipped as a
 11932	            // block (brace depth) or, for a brace-less item, through its `;`,
 11933	            // and scanning resumes after it. F-56: braces used to be
 11934	            // counted textually, strings and comments included, so an
 11935	            // unbalanced brace inside a test module could end the skip late
 11936	            // and hide a production spawn. Only structural braces count now,
 11937	            // the same scanner the mutant anchor screen uses.
 11938	            let mut skipping: Option<(usize, bool)> = None;
 11939	            let mut scanner = SourceScanner::default();
 11940	            for (index, line) in text.lines().enumerate() {
 11941	                let trimmed = line.trim();
 11942	                let structural = scanner.structural(line);
 11943	                if let Some((depth, entered)) = skipping.as_mut() {
 11944	                    *depth += structural.matches('{').count();
 11945	                    let closes = structural.matches('}').count();
 11946	                    if *depth > 0 {
 11947	                        *entered = true;
 11948	                    }
 11949	                    *depth = depth.saturating_sub(closes);
 11950	                    if (*entered && *depth == 0) || (!*entered && trimmed.ends_with(';')) {
 11951	                        skipping = None;
 11952	                    }
 11953	                    continue;
 11954	                }
 11955	                if trimmed.replace(' ', "") == "#[cfg(test)]" {
 11956	                    skipping = Some((0, false));
 11957	                    continue;
 11958	                }
 11959	                if trimmed.starts_with("//") {
 11960	                    continue;
 11961	                }
 11962	                for token in CONCURRENCY_EXECUTION_PRIMITIVES {
 11963	                    if line.contains(token) {
 11964	                        scan.execution
 11965	                            .push(format!("{relative}:{}:{token}", index + 1));
 11966	                    }
 11967	                }
 11968	                for token in CONCURRENCY_SYNC_PRIMITIVES {
 11969	                    if line.contains(token) {
 11970	                        scan.sync.push(format!("{relative}:{}:{token}", index + 1));
 11971	                    }
 11972	                }
 11973	            }
 11974	        }
 11975	    }
